host.label: apple-host
host.machine: Apple M3 (8 CPU cores, 10 GPU cores), 24 GiB unified memory
host.power: Battery Power, 99% at freeze (it had been on AC, finishing charge, minutes earlier), low-power mode off; the power source must stay unchanged within a window; every window's gate.json records the power source and battery level before and after
host.sharedUse: desktop session with the external display, browser, terminal and agent sessions; no computer-use or screen-capture session. 30 s idle measurement just before freeze with no GPU run of this campaign: idle GPU utilization median 1.5% (max 51%, one spike); summed ps %cpu median 72 of 800 (max 341). Another session's one-core Python analysis job ran earlier and had exited; windows are scheduled by the run script's settle loop and tools/wait_quiet.sh.

surface: dropin (public webgpu.h ABI); one harness source linked per provider, compiled with -DDOE_PHASE_BACKEND_METAL
workloadOrigin: unchanged amd-host C1 workloads; inputs manifest byte-identical to the amd-host and intel-host manifests (afe4e1d3...); independent CPU oracle on every iteration outside the timed interval

sampling.orders: all 24 permutations of the 4 providers, cycled

timing: CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW (Darwin CLOCK_MONOTONIC is quantized to 1 us); host clock, not GPU timestamps
phases: identical to amd-host contract-c1.json; complete = compile + pipeline + resources + sum of every iteration's operation + teardown
statistics: per-pair ratio provider/control; median ratio, bootstrap 95% CI (10000 resamples, seed 20261029), provider-faster pair count
gateLimits: Unchanged from b2/b3/m1r/m2r: idle GPU median <= 25% before and after, foreign CPU <= 20% of run-interval capacity (tools/mac_window.py, hash below).
gpuLock: Every timed window runs under `flock /tmp/doe-gpu-timing.lock`, the host-wide lock shared with other agents' Metal correctness and timing runs, held for that window only; scheduling (settle loop, tools/wait_quiet.sh) runs outside the lock.
rebuild: Libraries built with ZERO_AR_DATE=1 make -C runtime/c/native -j8 BUILD=<work>/build-<name>/native CC=clang from a git archive of main 1c585a5cc, the candidate patch applied with patch -p1. Dawn d04f88359 was rebuilt from a git archive with the b3 command (CMake Release, monolithic shared, Metal only); its bytes differ from the b3 receipt (c9e5faf8...) because the source path differs, and this contract names the rebuilt hash.
experiment: Owner-approved decision 1: Metal completion through the command buffer's completed handler (completion-candidate.patch). Every committed Metal command registers addCompletedHandler (Dawn QueueMTL.mm:234-240); a live device's submissions and lease drops no longer wake the progress worker under the device mutex (queue.c:298-305, lifecycle.c:287-288, pending_progress.c:33-49); the handler never takes the device mutex; destruction arms it to wake the worker. One mechanism; control is main 1c585a5cc.

providers.dawn: source-built Dawn d04f88359391a12375c1a3e948a0b2dcb4c97a18, CMake Release, DAWN_BUILD_MONOLITHIC_LIBRARY=SHARED, Metal only
providers.dawn-aa: byte-identical copy of the dawn harness binary (A/A control)

validity: every process status ok with all 32 iterations oracle-checked
every provider reports a Metal adapter that is not a CPU adapter
A/A: dawn-aa/dawn warm.operation median ratio within [0.95,1.05] and its CI95 contains 1, per workload
window gate (tools/mac_window.py) valid: power source and low-power mode unchanged, no thermal warning, idle GPU median <= 25% before and after, foreign CPU <= 20% of run-interval capacity
acceptance.mechanismRule: cand/main: warm.submit CI95 upper < 1.0 on vector_scale_add_262k and buffer_upload_readback_exact_1mb (the workloads with the +3.3-3.8 us submit gap against Dawn in b3; image submit was 0.99 of Dawn), and every noRegress metric, warm.submit on image included, CI95 lower <= 1.05 on every workload. Correctness recorded before freezing on these exact libraries: all 81 Metal physical clients give the same per-client result as main (61 pass, 13 abort on main too, 1 needs checker arguments, 6 GNU-only); backends/metal check, sdk-abi, native-check and native-graphics-check pass.
acceptance.diagnostic: cand/dawn and main/dawn warm.submit are reported from a summary with control dawn; they do not enter the verdict.
acceptance.invalidWindows: an invalid window is retained, never used for the verdict, and rerun fresh once under the unchanged contract
acceptance.claimBoundary: A pass accepts the mechanism for the Metal C runtime on apple-host only; it does not by itself make a scoped win against Dawn and says nothing about Vulkan or D3D12.

relation: New prospective experiment. It does not reinterpret b3, m1r or m2r.
